overall_notes: The paper focuses on language model inversion (prompt recovery) as its primary NLG task, with additional creative writing applications demonstrated. Automatic metrics are clearly used (ROUGE and cosine similarity), but no LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted. Human evaluation was performed with preference-based blind comparison. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some normalization and clarification.
